Sandbox_KnoxLifeBobcats_Enabled: Bobcats: add them to the world
Sandbox_KnoxLifeBobcats_Enabled_tooltip: Bobcat: deep cover and forest interior, avoiding open ground and people rather than exploiting them. Turn this off to leave bobcats out entirely: their routes are then not placed at all, and nothing else changes, because each species has its own target and none of them share a pool.
Sandbox_KnoxLifeBobcats_Routes_tooltip: Multiplies this species' population, on top of Wildlife density. This is the setting that changes how many bobcats actually exist. Does nothing unless bobcats are turned on above.
Sandbox_KnoxLifeBobcats_GroupSize_toolti: Multiplies the size of each bobcat group, on top of Group size. This does NOT change how many bobcats exist: the group count is divided to match, so you meet the same animals gathered into fewer, larger groups.
